designationHistory.name: Game Range
designationHistory.indexText: Cabeza Prieta National Wildlife Refuge was originally established in 1939 as a Game Range for the conservation and development of natural wildlife resources.
designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year. The refuge page does not say how it was established.
